summary.text: Sam Watford is a Republican state representative from North Carolina House District 80 who has served since 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a waterline contractor and previously served in the House from 2015 to 2019.

paragraphs.text: Watford graduated from East Davidson High School in 1971, and his career experience includes working as an underground utility contractor.
The General Assembly's website lists his occupation as waterline contractor.
Watford first served in the North Carolina House from 2015 to 2019, and he assumed office again on January 1, 2021, succeeding Steven Jarvis.
He advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026.

He represents Davidson County, and in the 2025-2026 session he chairs the State and Local Government Committee and is a member of the Agriculture and Environment, Energy and Public Utilities, Finance, and Housing and Development committees.
